changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_log_entry_provider_finalized_cost ON log_entry (provider_id, timestamp_request) INCLUDE (settled_cost_micro_cents) WHERE provider_id IS NOT NULL AND cost_finalized AND settled_cost_micro_cents > 0 AND result_status IN ('success', 'error', 'timeout');

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_log_entry_provider_finalized_cost;
